newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel's budget deficit widens in October.
newsitem.headline: Israel's budget deficit widens in October.

text.p: Israel posted a budget deficit of 1.029 billion shekels in October, excluding credit, preliminary figures from the Treasury show.
Note: Figures are in millions of shekels.
The government had a deficit of 9.782 billion shekels in the first 10 months of the year, excluding credit. The government had set a full-year deficit target of 7.6 billion shekels.
Expenditures from January to October totalled 101.207 billion shekels while revenue amounted to 91.424 billion.
